title: knowledge.retrieve_requested (v1)
description: An upstream agent (ProblemModelingAgent, DeepResearchAgent, NoveltyAuditAgent, CriticAgent, EvaluatorAgent, ReportAgent, or ResearchOrchestrator) asks KnowledgeIndexAgent to retrieve index entries matching a query. KnowledgeIndexAgent replies with knowledge.retrieve_result.

query.description: Free-text query to match against indexed entries.

top_k.description: Maximum number of entries to return. Optional; backend applies its own default if omitted.
